1.explanation: These files are directly related to the Menu component's behavior. The 'item.jsx' file handles individual Menu Item rendering, where the title attribute can be set or modified. The 'menu.jsx' file oversees the overall Menu structure, including how title attributes are applied. The 'config.jsx' file is relevant for implementing the proposed API to control title visibility, thus addressing the bug scenario.
1.bug_scenario: The issue involves the default addition of 'title' attributes to Menu Items, which causes problems when the title is identical to the inner text. This violates WCAG guidelines regarding duplicate text and affects user experience by displaying unwanted tooltip prompts. The proposed solution involves changing the title to 'aria-label' in some cases or conditionally applying the title based on the content type of Menu Item children.
